extract_OCR_errors: extract OCR errors from ground truth and predicted text files using Levenshtein edit operations
measure_ocr_error_rate: measure character and word error rates between OCR output and ground truth text files
read_monolingual_data: read and filter monolingual data from CC100 or WikiMatrix sources for a given language code
introduce_errors_in_monolingual: introduce replacement deletion and insertion errors into monolingual text data at a specified error rate
read_finetuning_results: read and compile finetuning results into a sorted CSV with spBLEU scores and error rates
